manifest.notes: Sepolia (11155111). Deploy LaunchToken before Soapbox; $token resolves to the deployed SOAP address. Both constructors are nonpayable. Soapbox has no privileged roles and requires no initial SOAP funding or initialization calls. Posting transfers 100 SOAP to the dead address; tips transfer SOAP directly to post authors. The pool pairs SOAP with native ETH and has no hook. The pinned policy determines the effective opening price when specified; initialPrice is the legacy sqrtPriceX96 fallback. Policy, signed artifact linkage, admission and deployment are service responsibilities.

abiInstructions: Build ABIs from this exact source commit; compare canonicalKeccak(abi) with abiHash. Verify deployed code on the stated chain before enabling transactions.
